To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) opinion extraction is a very useful technique for mining and understanding opinions; 2) opinion summarization is a very important tool for understanding opinions; 3) opinion tracking is a useful tool for understanding trends of opinions; 4) opinion mining from news and blogs can be used to understand opinions from heterogeneous information source.

(1) opinion extraction, summarization and tracking are useful for opinion understanding; (2) the proposed algorithms are effective in opinion extraction and summarization; (3) the proposed opinion tracking system is helpful to monitor opinions along the time line

(i) the opinion extraction system is able to identify opinion words, sentences and documents, (ii) the opinion summarization system is able to summarize opinions in different languages, from different sources, and (iii) the opinion tracking system is able to show supportive and nonsupportative degrees along the timeline.
